meta.siteDescription: Independent medical information about cosmetic surgery and aesthetic medicine, and contact with qualified, verified surgeons.

footer.disclaimer: The information on this site does not replace a medical consultation. Only a qualified surgeon, after examining you, can tell you whether a procedure is right for you.
footer.independence: Independent platform: no commission on procedures, no paid rankings.

home.title: Understand before you decide
home.lead: Clear medical information, risks included, and surgeons whose qualifications we check. No sales pressure.

info.title: Complete information
info.text: Every page covers who a procedure suits, who it doesn't, its risks and recovery.

verified.title: Verified surgeons
verified.text: We check every surgeon's qualifications against the official register in their country.

choice.title: You choose
choice.text: Your request only goes to the surgeons you select. You stay in control of your data.

home.reflectionText: UK professional standards recommend at least two weeks between your consultation and agreeing to surgery. That time is yours.

reflection.q2: Does this concern stop you going out, working or seeing people close to you?

methodology.title: How we work
body: Content: every guide follows an editorial charter that rules out any promise of results and requires a section on risks. It is reviewed by a named, qualified surgeon, with the review date shown.
Surgeon verification: we check every surgeon against the official register in their country, then again every year.
Ranking: surgeons are listed by specialty, location and languages spoken. No surgeon can pay to rank higher.
Funding: surgeons pay a fixed subscription, regardless of how many requests they receive. We take no commission on procedures.
